values.title: Schema
values.summary: Define tables, columns and relations in TypeScript. The schema drives the database, the API and the client.
values.body:
## Tables and columns

A table is a named collection of typed columns. Column builders map directly to Postgres types, and modifiers like `.notNull()` and `.unique()` become constraints.

schema.ts

```
import { table, uuid, text, integer, timestamp } from "tessera"
 
export const projects = table("projects", {
  id: uuid().primaryKey(),
  name: text().notNull(),
  slug: text().notNull().unique(),
  seats: integer().default(5),
  createdAt: timestamp().defaultNow(),
})
```

## Relations

Use `references()` to link tables. Tessera creates the foreign key and adds typed helpers to the client for joins.

schema.ts

```
export const tasks = table("tasks", {
  id: uuid().primaryKey(),
  projectId: uuid().references(() => projects.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  title: text().notNull(),
})
```

Rename safely

Renaming a column in the schema is detected as a rename, not a drop and add, so existing data is kept.
